components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single high-emphasis route into the capture guide.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-block; background: var(--ledger-ink, #182825); border: 1px solid var(--ledger-ink, #182825); border-radius: .35rem; color: var(--ledger-paper, #f6f3e9); font: 620 1rem/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; padding: .65rem .9rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--ledger-teal-dark, #07564f); border-color: var(--ledger-teal-dark, #07564f); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ledger-teal, #0c7167); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Release Strip
components.description: A compact ruled record of release, schema, and matrix state.
components.css: .ds-release-strip { border-block: 1px solid var(--ledger-rule, #c9c9bc); color: var(--ledger-muted, #56635f); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; font: .7rem/1.45 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-release-strip span { padding: .55rem 1rem .55rem 0; } .ds-release-strip span + span { border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ledger-rule, #c9c9bc); padding-inline-start: 1rem; } .ds-release-strip strong { color: var(--ledger-ink, #182825); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Capture Pipeline
components.description: The four accountable stages from target to snapshot.
components.html:
1. TargetPage or driver session
  2. AdapterAccessible browser state
  3. CoreValidate, retry, transform
  4. SnapshotSchema 1 or TQ1
components.css: .ds-pipeline { border-block: 1px solid var(--ledger-rule, #c9c9bc); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; } .ds-pipeline::before { background: var(--ledger-teal, #0c7167); content: ''; height: 2px; inset: -1px 0 auto; position: absolute; } .ds-pipeline li { padding: 1rem .75rem 1.15rem; } .ds-pipeline li + li { border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ledger-rule, #c9c9bc); } .ds-pipeline b, .ds-pipeline span { display: block; } .ds-pipeline b { font: 600 .72rem/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pipeline span { color: var(--ledger-muted, #56635f); font: .78rem/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; margin-top: .38rem; }

components.name: Supported Status
components.description: A textual support state reinforced by a filled square.
components.css: .ds-status-supported { align-items: center; color: var(--ledger-teal-dark, #07564f); display: inline-flex; font: 600 .75rem/1.45 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; gap: .45rem; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-supported::before { background: var(--ledger-teal, #0c7167); content: ''; height: .5rem; width: .5rem; }

components.name: Unavailable Status
components.description: An unavailable state reinforced by a hollow square.
components.css: .ds-status-unavailable { align-items: center; color: var(--ledger-rust, #a84d2b); display: inline-flex; font: 600 .75rem/1.45 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; gap: .45rem; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-unavailable::before { border: 1px solid currentColor; box-sizing: border-box; content: ''; height: .5rem; width: .5rem; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The current page uses text weight and a leading evidence square instead of a pill.
components.css: .ds-nav a { color: var(--ledger-ink, #182825); display: inline-block; font: .88rem/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; padding: .4rem .5rem; position: relative; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ledger-teal-dark, #07564f); font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::before { background: var(--ledger-teal, #0c7167); content: ''; height: .45rem; inset-inline-start: -.7rem; position: absolute; top: .7rem; width: .45rem; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ledger-teal, #0c7167); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Domstamp's documentation behaves like an exact technical field ledger: calm, compact, and accountable. Warm paper surfaces make long reading comfortable; mineral ink and fine rules establish hierarchy; scarce evidence teal marks navigation, support, and action. The system favors searchable knowledge, explicit capability boundaries, and information density over promotional composition.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and mineral-ink materiality in light mode, with a purpose-built dark theme.
Editorial serif headings paired with highly legible sans-serif prose and monospaced evidence labels.
Thin rules, tabular structures, and small square status marks in place of decorative containers.
Evidence teal is reserved for action, focus, active navigation, and confirmed support.
Motion is rare, brief, and disabled when reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: The Evidence Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies interaction or verified support; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Honest Exception Rule
rules.body: Rust communicates a real unavailable boundary, never ordinary emphasis.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif explains hierarchy, sans serif carries knowledge, and mono records evidence; do not exchange their roles casually.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Responsive metadata does not fall below the implemented 0.75rem label size and 1.45 line height.

rules.name: The Lossless Responsive Rule
rules.body: A smaller viewport may transform structure, but it must not remove package fields, capability boundaries, or status meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from rules and tonal surfaces first; shadow is functional separation, not ornament.

dos: Do make availability, schema, version, and test status explicit.
Do use one-pixel rules and tonal surfaces to establish information structure.
Do preserve visible focus, semantic labels, reduced-motion behavior, and mobile information completeness.
Do keep introductory copy compact enough that documentation begins above the fold.
donts: Don't add an oversized hero, ornamental gradient, or promotional illustration to the documentation home.
Don't use teal as a general background decoration or rust for ordinary emphasis.
Don't turn navigation items, capability rows, or route lists into a field of floating rounded cards.
Don't reduce metadata below its responsive legibility floor or solve narrow layouts by clipping content.
